monsters.name: Cinder hound
monsters.text: A rangy grey hound with ash caked in its coat and eyes like coals in a dying grate. They hunt the road in pairs and never bark.

monsters.name: Ash reaver
monsters.text: A raider in charred furs and a dented helm, left over from a war that ended without him. He has been living off the Marches for twelve years and has stopped expecting mercy.

monsters.name: Ash wraith
monsters.text: A shape of grey ash held together by black briar, roughly the size of a villager. It drifts toward you with its hands out, as if it wants to be let in from the cold.

monsters.name: Thorn Choir zealot
monsters.text: A gaunt singer in a robe stitched with thorns, who keeps humming the three-note hymn while trying to put a briar-wrapped knife into you.

monsters.name: Briar knight
monsters.text: One of the knights who died at Greyford, still in his plate, black briar growing through every joint of it. He fights as he was trained, which is the worst part.

monsters.name: Millpond drowner
monsters.text: Something long and pale that was once an eel, swollen huge on twelve years of ash and grown through with briar. It has been coiled round the Tarrow bell like a dragon round a hoard.

on_defeat.message: The drowner sinks in a slick of black water. Where it lay, green with weed, is the Tarrow bell. You get your arms round it and haul it out onto the bank.

monsters.name: Ser Halvard Grey, the Ashen Knight
monsters.text: A tall knight in plate gone grey with ash, a crown of briar grown up through his gorget, still holding the ford he was told to hold twelve years ago.

on_defeat.message: Ser Halvard goes down on one knee in the shallows, and then the briar lets go of him all at once. The ash that was his body runs away downstream. His sword stays where it fell, point-down in the ford.
